cohort: The study included 218 pregnant Japanese women in the non-high risk group for HDP with uncomplicated pregnancies, who self-measured and recorded their home blood pressure daily.
finding: The study defined normal HBPM ranges during pregnancy and postpartum, established gestational-age-specific hypertensive cut-offs, and found that HBPM can be used for both HDP determination and early detection.
gest_age: From 15 weeks of gestation up to 30 weeks of gestation, and post-24 weeks of gestation
